Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when an effect trashes this card from the security stack" when this card is directly trashed from the security stack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate the "when an effect trashes this card from the security stack" effect when this card is revealed from the security stack or when searching/looking at this card from the security stack?

Effect: When effects trash this card from the security stack, you may play 1 level 4 or lower [Angel] or [Iliad] trait card from your hand without paying the cost.
